Literal.Value:
'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• X-R2.1 — Resource Utilization Orchestration
  Owner: head_of_workforce_management
  Impact: High, RiskAvoidance
  Expected: 3.0–8.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained utilization band violations for this queue
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant utilization driver for this queue
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this queue
  ⚠ Trigger only if deviation is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if utilization deviation is caused by approved surge coverage

• X-R2.2 — Capacity Reallocation & Load Balancing
  Owner: workforce_management_lead
  Impact: High, RiskAvoidance
  Expected: 4.0–10.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY queues with sustained utilization imbalance
  · REALLOCATE capacity across queues or channels for this queue cluster
  · VALIDATE SLA and backlog impact for this queue daily
  ⚠ Trigger only if imbalance is queue-structural, not individual
  ⚠ Do not trigger if imbalance is caused by approved surge coverage

• X-R2.3 — Shrinkage & Productive Time Control
  Owner: service_operations_manager
  Trigger: res.shrinkage.pct > 30.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -3.0–-8.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY queues or agent groups with elevated shrinkage
  · ANALYSE dominant shrinkage categories for this queue or agent group
  · ADJUST planning, adherence, or scheduling practices for this queue or agent group
  ⚠ Trigger only if shrinkage is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if increase is driven by approved training plans

• X-R2.4 — Overtime & Fatigue Containment
  Owner: service_operations_manager
  Trigger: res.overtime.pct > 12.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -2.0–-6.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY queues with recurring overtime
  · ANALYSE root causes (demand spikes, misallocation, shrinkage) for this queue
  · ADJUST schedules, REALLOCATE capacity, or CORRECT planning gaps for this queue
  ⚠ Trigger only if overtime is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if overtime is driven by approved peak coverage'
